_comment: Baselines for the daily agent-version watch (scripts/check-agent-versions.py). `verified` is the version whose on-disk session/config format was last checked against our parsers; null means never verified. `sources` lists every channel the CLI ships through (npm, Homebrew, release feeds) — a major/minor bump on ANY channel counts as drift, because users install from different ones (e.g. OpenCode 2.x ships only via Homebrew core).

opencode.notes: SQLite opencode.db; session_message moved to message+part once already

kiro.notes: Flat files ~/.kiro/sessions/cli/{id}.json + .jsonl; transcripts carry no token counts

codex.notes: JSONL rollouts; parser tolerates unknown event types

gemini.notes: Two on-disk formats coexist (.json snapshot, .jsonl stream)

agy.notes: No public version feed; check by hand. Binary conversations/<id>.db is not parsed

sources.label: brew cask (Antigravity app — may not track the agy CLI)
sources.name: antigravity

claude.notes: First-party format read by our own native parser
